heading: OPENAI RESPONDS TO DEPARTED SAFETY RESEARCHERS (2 MINUTE READ)
blurb: OpenAI says it dismissed three safety researchers for violating sensitive-information policies, not for raising safety concerns. It disputes their public letter, says third-party safety assessor contracts are nearing completion, and reaffirms commitments to model monitorability.

heading: AMAZON IN TALKS TO BUY AI STARTUP DECART FOR AROUND $7 BILLION (4 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Decart's software makes it easier for developers to switch between different AI chips.
